ui_bugs.component: CustomerBits.jsx ledger rows (shown on Booking › Ledger and C360 › Money) at <768 px
ui_bugs.issue: The stacked ledger cards overlap each other: dates, amounts and labels from different rows are drawn on top of each other. RCA: each <tr> has className 'h-11' (fixed 44 px height). Under the stack-table media query the tr becomes display:block, so the fixed height clips the much taller stacked card and its content spills into the next row. Fix: use 'md:h-11' (or min-h).

Only BookingDetail's local Table uses useStackLabels. LedgerTable.jsx, CustomerBits ledger-rows, C360Tabs demands-tab (line ~341) and C360Tabs receipts-list (line ~448) never set td[data-label], so their cards show bare values: 0 of 135 / 56 / 70 cells are labelled. In the ledger this makes Bill raised vs Received vs Balance impossible to tell apart. Fix: apply useStackLabels (or static data-label) to these tables and to DataTable.
The card is 402 px wide in a 390 px viewport. The page does not scroll, but the card's right border and edge are cut off (visible in the screenshot).
BookingDetail.jsx:213 still reads b.payment_plan_name, which the API never returns, so the plan pill never appears. Only the dialog was switched to payment_plan_snapshot.name.

issues: '₹41.8 L' and '₹32.4 L' still wrap onto two lines next to the sparkline (left over from iteration 39).
The column header 'Demand', the button 'Raise manual demand' and the other-charge button 'Demand now' still use the word 'demand' (JRN-70 bans it).

action_items: CustomerBits ledger rows: change tr 'h-11' to 'md:h-11' so stacked cards do not overlap on phones (HIGH).
Add stack labels (useStackLabels or data-label) to LedgerTable, CustomerBits ledger-rows, C360 demands-tab and receipts-list (and DataTable).
Fix the C360 receipts-list card overflowing the 390 px viewport (402 px).
BookingDetail hero plan pill: use b.payment_plan_snapshot?.name.
Optional: remove the remaining 'demand' wording on the Bills tab; stop the C360 key-strip amounts wrapping on phones.
critical_code_review_comments: MainAction: `if (rules && !r.pay_refund)` relies on pay_refund being null when allowed. This is fine if the server returns a reason string when the refund is blocked, but it was not verifiable (no cancelled booking has a pending refund).
useStackLabels is local to BookingDetail's Table. Make it shared behaviour of every stack-table so new tables do not regress.
